items: The cross terms are $2x$ and $-6x$, which sum to $-4x$. The constant product is $-12$.
The numbers 5 and 2 add to 7 and multiply to 10. Set $(x+5)(x+2)=0$.
Which value of $x$ is a solution of $6x^2-15x=0$ other than zero?
The square is zero at $x=-4$. It is positive at other inputs, and its coefficient 3 is positive.
For which value of $c$ does $2x^2+12x+c=0$ have one repeated real root?
Set the discriminant $144-8c$ to zero, giving $c=18$.
The product of two consecutive positive integers is 156. What is the smaller integer?
Write $n(n+1)=156$. Then $(n-12)(n+13)=0$. The positive root is 12.
What is the greatest value of $-2x^2+16x-21$ over the real numbers?
The axis is $x=-16/(2(-2))=4$. Substituting 4 gives $-32+64-21=11$. The graph opens downward.
In a model, profit is $P(x)=-x^2+14x-20$ and production may range only from 0 through 5 units. Where is modeled profit greatest?
The unrestricted maximum is at 7. On the allowed interval up to 5, the graph is still increasing. The greatest permitted input is 5.
